## Running Tests in Container
```bash
docker exec -w /app \\
  -e TEST_DATABASE_URL="postgresql://surreynest:2468@postgres:5432/surreynest_test" \\
  surreynest-backend \\
  python -m pytest -v tests/
```

## Copying Files to Container
Since only `backend/data` is volume-mounted, new Python files must be copied:
```bash
docker cp path/to/file.py surreynest-backend:/app/app/.../file.py
```

## Alembic Migrations
Migration files must also be copied into the container before running upgrade:
```bash
docker cp backend/alembic/versions/xxx.py surreynest-backend:/app/alembic/versions/
docker exec surreynest-backend alembic upgrade head
```
